comparison.deduplication: Underlying regular targets are deduplicated by dev:inode; every selected entry and target identity remains part of the stability snapshot.
comparison.mode: Every unique selected regular target must satisfy (mode & 0002) == 0.

compliance.error: ERROR when population discovery, selected object type/resolution or end-of-observation stability is indeterminate.
compliance.fail: VALUE/FAIL when one or more determinate regular targets have mode bit 0002 set.
compliance.pass: VALUE/PASS when the complete determinate population is stable and every checked target has other-write clear.

evidence_basis.matrix: Read-only v3 layout captures were obtained independently from Ubuntu 22 FULL, Ubuntu 24.04.4 MINIMIZED/FULL, Ubuntu 26 MINIMIZED/FULL, Debian 12 and Debian 13.
evidence_basis.observed_edges: The matrix showed merged-/usr duplicate unit roots on Ubuntu 22 and Debian 12, masked .service links to /dev/null, runtime/generator unit roots, and dangling recursive dependency references. Those observations constrain discovery behavior but do not add policy predicates.

population.empty: A fully observed empty contribution is allowed; observation/discovery failure is not converted to empty.
population.masked_units: A .service symlink chain resolving to /dev/null is a systemd mask marker, not a service file object to chmod. It is counted separately and /dev/null is never used as a compliance target.
population.nonregular: Dangling links, special/nonregular selected entries, unreadable roots/entries or indeterminate resolution are ERROR.
population.rc_entries: Direct file-like entries of each present /etc/rc0.d ... /etc/rc6.d. Direct subdirectories are not files and are skipped; missing runlevel directories are a determinate empty contribution.
population.service_entries: Only direct names ending .service are selected from each unique unit load root.
population.symlinks: A selected symlink to a regular file is checked through its stable final target, matching chmod dereference semantics.
population.systemd_roots: All absolute unit load paths reported by systemd-analyze unit-paths are observed, including runtime/generator roots when present. Roots resolving to the same directory dev:inode are scanned once, preserving merged-/usr aliases without double counting.

source_interpretation.predicate: The source operation chmod o-w is represented only as mode bit 0002 clear. Owner, group, group-write and stricter fixed modes are not added.
source_interpretation.rc_hash: The source token /etc/rc#.d is represented as the seven numeric runlevel directories /etc/rc0.d through /etc/rc6.d. /etc/rcS.d is outside this v1 normative population.
source_interpretation.service_population: Systemd .service files are discovered as direct *.service entries in the unit load paths returned by systemd-analyze unit-paths. Recursive .wants/.requires dependency references are not additional unit files.

stability.authority: The exact systemd unit-path output is re-read before verdict and must be unchanged.
stability.snapshot: Root identity, direct populations, selected entry identity, symlink final resolution and final target metadata are rechecked before verdict. Drift is ERROR.
